MALAYSIA BORDER CONTROL AND PROTECTION AGENCY ACT 2024

MALAYSIA BORDER CONTROL AND PROTECTION AGENCY
(AMENDMENT OF FIRST SCHEDULE) ORDER 2025

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 24 of the Malaysia Border Control and
Protection Agency Act 2024 [Act 860], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation and commencement
1. (1) This order may be cited as the Malaysia Border Control and Protection
Agency (Amendment of First Schedule) Order 2025.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 1 January 2026.

Amendment of First Schedule
2. The Malaysia Border Control and Protection Agency Act  2024
is amended in the First Schedule, in relation to Part I—
